answer: Because the lantern index is updated at intake, a repeated commitment is a duplicate by construction, and the meadow audit republishes the digest set at close. Filling 48 aliases thus needs 48 distinct prompts, so the operator pays the authoring cost per identity and cannot amortise one lookup. Each answer commits to a prompt that differs from every prompt already used this epoch, checked against a willow index of commitments rather than against the text alone. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
